title: What is American Dynamism?

reader_summary.headline: The term coined by A16C general partner, Catherine Boyle, just two years ago.
reader_summary.overview: The term coined by A16C general partner, Catherine Boyle, just two years ago, when she and David Olovich founded the firm's American dynamism investing practice. But since then, the term has truly taken on a life of its own. of builders, to others, it's a spirit grounded in innovation.

key_points.text: And some others might even call it a movement.
key_points.evidence_quote: And some others might even call it a movement.

key_points.text: In the words of Catherine herself, American dynamism is not a sector.
key_points.evidence_quote: In the words of Catherine herself, American dynamism is not a sector.

key_points.text: It doesn't fit neatly into one vertical or portfolio.
key_points.evidence_quote: It doesn't fit neatly into one vertical or portfolio.

key_points.text: It is a philosophy that encompasses nearly every aspect of American life and leadership.
key_points.evidence_quote: It is a philosophy that encompasses nearly every aspect of American life and leadership.

thesis: The podcast introduces the concept of American dynamism, a philosophy coined by A16Z general partner Catherine Boyle that encompasses nearly every aspect of American life and leadership rather than being a specific sector. The episode features founders and leaders from various fields—including aerospace, public safety, education, and energy—who define American dynamism as a spirit of optimism, innovation, and national pride aimed at solving community problems and protecting Western values.
